summary: Write d·q^k = c·m; for l coprime to q, ι(q) is an l-adic unit, so |ι(d/c)| = |ι(m)|·|ι(q)|^{−k} = |ι(m)| ≤ 1.

steps.claim: Fix a prime l coprime to q (the hypothesis is named c here) and a ring homomorphism ι : ℂ → ℂ_l; it remains to show |ι(d/c)|_l ≤ 1.

By h, d·q^k = c·m for a natural number m. Since l does not divide q, |ι(q)|_l = 1, so taking norms gives |ι(d)| = |ι(c)|·|ι(m)|; hence |ι(d/c)| = |ι(m)| ≤ 1, because the image of a natural number lies in the valuation ring of ℂ_l.
